tests.summary: Validate schemas, Markdown parity, bidirectional mappings, aggregate gates, legacy separation, and defect propagation.
tests.reviewer_note: The contract runner exists; TEST-016 remains NOT_STARTED because the complete release quality matrix does not yet exist.

tests.summary: Verify the frozen M02 scenario, clean/same-process reset, forbidden scope, and scripted passenger-bus trajectory.
tests.reviewer_note: Two complete offline current-Ubuntu oracle campaigns are byte-identical; all focused mutation tests, 96 upstream unit cases, and two native regressions pass.

tests.summary: Verify the frozen M03 framing, lifecycle, process isolation, configurable tick scheduler, native command path, failure handling, soak, and non-perturbation contract.
tests.reviewer_note: Two complete current-Ubuntu campaigns are byte-identical; 98 native CTest entries and the focused M03 repository suite pass.

tests.summary: Verify the frozen M04 structured/spatial encoder, source semantics, preprocessing equivalence, actual-engine goldens, compatibility rejection, and non-perturbation.
tests.reviewer_note: Two complete current-Ubuntu campaigns are byte-identical; all 32 channels have positive fixtures and every scalar/tile transform is independently compared to the engine source projection.

tests.summary: Verify the frozen M05 action catalog, mask semantics, native execution, transaction rollback, typed failures, actual-engine goldens, and useful bus-service trajectory.
tests.reviewer_note: Two complete current-Ubuntu campaigns are byte-identical; 614 production/native-oracle mask states match and every template constructs service, delivers passengers, and receives revenue.

tests.summary: Verify native M06 rewards, typed episode outcomes, exact trajectories, actual-engine rollover, all reward components, and exploit resistance.
tests.reviewer_note: Twenty-one focused tests, 98 native CTest entries, and two complete byte-identical eight-template campaigns pass; actual 128-transition bundles, quarterly rollover, combined horizon, bankruptcy, vehicle loss, and adversarial returns are retained.

tests.summary: Verify trusted native CPU PPO math, structured MLP learning, masking, numerics, monitoring, exact recovery, development selection, and extended live OpenTTD stability.
tests.reviewer_note: Eight focused Python tests, four native CTest targets, a 14-vector scalar differential, tiny deterministic learning, exact interrupted/uninterrupted recovery, numerical injection, and the retained 64-update/8,192-transition live campaign pass.

tests.summary: Verify frozen M08 MLP/CNN/combined models, multimodal PPO, CPU/CUDA equivalence, measured workloads, device failures, monitoring, checkpoints, sample efficiency, and live OpenTTD semantics.
tests.reviewer_note: Seven focused Python tests, six native M08 tests, paired CPU/CUDA learning, a 12-cell full benchmark with continuous telemetry, real unavailable/OOM failures, canonical checkpoint moves, and a matched all-architecture live OpenTTD run pass.
